---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea to improve the app
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## 💡 Feature Description
*A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.*

## 🎯 Problem Statement
*What problem does this feature solve? How does it help children's safety?*

## 📱 Proposed Solution
*Describe your ideal solution. How would it work from a user perspective?*

## 🔄 User Stories
*As a [user type], I want [feature] so that [benefit].*
- As a parent, I want...
- As a child, I want...
- As a teacher, I want...

## 🎨 Design Ideas
*If you have thoughts on how this should look or work:*
- UI/UX suggestions
- Wireframes or mockups (optional)
- Similar apps/features for inspiration

## 🔧 Technical Considerations
*Any technical thoughts or constraints:*
- Implementation complexity
- Potential challenges
- Dependencies required
- Performance impact

## 📊 Impact Assessment
*How would this feature help:*
- [ ] Improve child safety
- [ ] Better user experience
- [ ] Reach more users
- [ ] Reduce emergency response time
- [ ] Other: *describe*

## 🚀 Priority
- [ ] Critical - Safety critical feature
- [ ] High - Major improvement
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Future consideration

## 🤝 Willing to Contribute
- [ ] Yes, I can help implement this
- [ ] Yes, I can help test this
- [ ] Yes, I can help design this
- [ ] No, but I'd love to see it

## 📋 Additional Context
*Any other information, links, or resources about this feature.*

---

**Thank you for suggesting ways to keep children safer!** 🛡️
